parsed.name: 示例虚拟仪器
parsed.description: 一个用于实验控制软件测试、演示和流程验证的示例性虚拟仪器，不对应明确的实际硬件型号。它可用于模拟参数更新、数值读取、连接状态检查、复位和控制输出等常见实验仪器交互。
parsed.description_en: A sample virtual instrument used for testing, demonstration, and workflow validation in laboratory control software. It does not correspond to a specific physical hardware model, but can simulate common instrument interactions such as parameter updates, value readout, connection checks, reset, and controller output handling.

actions.description_en: Read the current value of a specified probe or measurement item.
